title: UX-054 administration boundary with step screenshots

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given ADMIN-A has T1 record101 loaded with Tile Name "Old" and a request-persisting successful save fixture

steps.title: Install clock "Thu Oct 22 2026 13:48:27 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
Pause clock "Thu Oct 22 2026 13:49:27 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. When ADMIN-A types "New" as the replacement value in the textbox labelled "Tile Name" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
3. And The controlled event loop advances 301 milliseconds from the final input event
4. And ADMIN-A clicks the button labelled "Update" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
5. And The controlled event loop completes every pending field callback and save response
6. Then The captured update payload has title equal to "New"
7. When The browser fixture reloads the Tile page from the persisted received payload
8. Then The Tile grid row with "Record Id" equal to "101" contains "Tile Name" equal to "New"
9. When ADMIN-A clicks the button labelled "Edit" in the Tile grid row with "Record Id" equal to "101" on the administration page
10. Then The textbox labelled "Tile Name" in the dialog with title text "edit ID: 101" on the administration page has value equal to "New"

annotations.description: Actual React administration screens. Controlled browser credentials, role, records, and BFF responses. Save probes persist the received UI payload without replacing it with expected values. Declared clock emulation controls field timers. Proposed accessibility and source-risk expectations remain separate from business approval.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
